title: Dev F Progression barre stuck
body:
@MilosKozak As we talked on Discord, with the last dev f, the progression barre gets stuck till next BG reading and stops data being sent to watch.

![Screenshot_20241212_173245_AAPS.jpg](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/7ecc7c5e-2b66-48fa-90ad-d13f371aa36a)

![IMG-20241212-WA0001.jpg](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c429f3a8-62f1-466b-82e7-ac7f717e1d22)

Pulling on the Loop tab gives a black screen on loop and AutoISF

![Screenshot_20241212_190905_AAPS.jpg](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f4d12a9b-b916-41aa-87f8-d4f0428c2092)

![Screenshot_20241212_190910_AAPS.jpg](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/cf22eaa6-091e-4402-bcd0-5dbb218b4d56)

The problem seems only with AutoISF (but that needs to be tested) and since the arrival of Dev F. Last dev E was working OK.

Here are the logs. See around 19:11

![AndroidAPS_LOG_1734027130885.log.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/18117453/AndroidAPS_LOG_1734027130885.log.zip)

comments.body:
Dev-e was ok till 09.12.2024. Dev-e from 10.12.2024, has the Problem. Picture is from last dev-e, that was working ok. 
![Screenshot_20241212-211924](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d015553f-cfe6-4ce9-b7e6-b9c4bef1ff08)
Nope. I switched to OpenSMB to test and it seems to work ok. Didn't check with the watch really but no more progression barre stuck on the main UI.
Without autoISF, on Standard SMB, everything is ok. Also Watch is getting BG immediately.
Confirming: Have been running OpenSMB/DASH for one hour now. No issue...

@MilosKozak Just had the _black screen then the UI "refilling"_  when BG came in and the loop kicked in **but** I was using OpenSMB !!!

So, not only an AutoISF problem...

Look at the logs around 23:45

![AndroidAPS_LOG_1734043636553.log.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/18118289/AndroidAPS_LOG_1734043636553.log.zip)
i don't see the issue. Please go commit by commit to find out which broke it for you
